title: Surface empty BCPT results as a warning instead of silent success
summary: BCPT performance tests that run but produce no log entries now show a warning instead of silently succeeding, making empty results visible in the GitHub step summary.
key_points: GetBcptSummaryMD now distinguishes between missing results files and files with no entries
Empty BCPT results generate an informational message in the GitHub step summary
AnalyzeTests emits a warning annotation as a defense-in-depth measure when results file exists but is empty
Tests added for ReadBcptFile and GetBcptSummaryMD to cover missing and empty result scenarios
Build no longer succeeds silently when BCPT tests produce no output
